entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you with your VeloFit gear today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling about an order. I... I think I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number?
Yes, it's Mark Sterling, order number VF78910. I've been a customer for years and I was so excited for this new jersey. I saved up for it, and now I just feel... well, silly.

I see your order, Mark. It's for the ProFit Jersey. I understand it's frustrating when something doesn't work out. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit. I ordered my usual size, but I think it's the wrong size for this model. It's just way too tight in the shoulders and chest. I was hoping to wear it for a big charity ride this month, and now I can't. I feel bad even calling about it.
Please don't feel bad at all, that's what we're here for. Getting the right fit is the most important thing. It looks like your jersey was delivered 14 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Okay. I was just worried because it's been a couple of weeks. I really needed that money back if I couldn't use it.

Not a problem at all, Mark. Our policy for standard items like this is a 90-day return window. Since you're well within that time, we can absolutely process this for you. Would you prefer an exchange for a different size, or would you like a full refund?
Oh! Really? A full 90 days? That's... that's fantastic. I was so stressed about this. Yes, an exchange would be perfect, I'd love to try the next size up. Thank you so much, Diana.

You're very welcome. I'm glad we could sort this out. I've just initiated the exchange for you and sent a pre-paid return label to your email on file. Just send the original jersey back to us, and we'll ship out the new size.
That's a huge relief. You've been incredibly helpful. Thanks again.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a great day.
You too, Mark. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
